reviewed_by: Claude review of the standing tool-result sharing consent
reason: Chat and missions asked for tool-result sharing on every turn because consent lived only in the request. Provider and harness profiles now carry privacy.auto_share_tool_results (valid only alongside permits_sensitive_data), the confirmation dialog offers an 'Always allow' checkbox that stores it, and chat, missions and the harness runtime treat the stored consent as the per-turn confirmation. Selected: the chat, harness, mission and domain Python suites for the privacy gates and the new model validator; the API client, consent helper, confirmation dialog, mission and harness settings frontend tests for the wire shape, checkbox and persistence; the mocked desktop assistant Playwright entry for the composer and dialog it renders.
exclusions: No full suites. Provider, API and knowledge suites are unchanged: the new field is additive, defaults to false, and rides the existing provider/harness PATCH path already covered by test_api_crud_validation and the API client tests. Playwright runs desktop only: the mocked assistant entry covers the confirmation dialog markup, and mobile projects add nothing for a dialog with no phone-specific layout. The real-Core journeys are not rerun because no runtime wiring outside the privacy gates changed. The rollover-stub failure this selection first surfaced in test_harnesses.py was fixed upstream by #365 and is merged in here, so the harness suite passes. The Vertex provider case in ui/src/App.test.tsx times out under full-suite parallel load on main (29a29dd) as well and is unrelated.
